lines.text: Good morning everyone. Welcome, let's get started.
So, I run a community called OpenSverige.
It's Sweden's open community for AI agents and vibe coding.
And it all started in a Discord server. Nothing fancy.
Just a bunch of people who wanted to build things instead of talking about building things.
Today I want to tell you three things.
One, we ship. Two, we share. Three, we never wait for permission.
People always ask me, how big is it?
Honestly, it grew faster than anyone expected.
A year ago we were a handful of friends. Now there are thousands of people in the server.
And about eighty percent of them have shipped something with an AI agent.
Which is a crazy number, because ten years ago that would have been zero.
Here's the funny part. Half of our channels are in Swedish.
So we built a bot that translates everything into English.
Which means the whole world can now read our arguments about tabs versus spaces.
Bill, tabs versus spaces
Now, the real problem in Sweden is that everybody is very polite.
Nobody wants to say, this idea is bad. They just go, hmm, interesting.
We call it the Swedish silence.
Bill, give me the Swedish silence
But when something actually works, people lose their minds.
Last month someone built a full app in one weekend.
Bill, hoo-ah
Of course, then the AI deleted the database.
Classic. Nothing says vibe coding like a missing production database.
So, what are we building next?
We want a real place in Stockholm where the community can meet. A proper venue, with real coffee.
And honestly? A taco bar in the lobby.
Bill, how many people live in Sweden?
It's a small country, which is exactly why we move fast.
Our growth over the last three years looked something like this. Slow, slow, boom.
And that boom is the AI agents.
The future is not a chatbot. It's agents doing the boring work while we do the interesting work.
If you remember one thing from today, ship it.
Thank you all, see you in the Discord.
